owner_priority_lock.rule: Follow the explicit owner direction to pause technical_refactor and prioritize tour-search UX and user-facing visual work on AnyTour Design System 2.0.

current_stage.name: Representative country/editorial DS2 re-audit after public-route hierarchy pass
current_stage.last_material_progress: PR #690 fixed the remaining visual-hierarchy defect on /rb/: three independent early-booking benefits were incorrectly rendered with the numbered DS2 step primitive, implying a false 1→2→3 process. They now use the canonical responsive sp-grid + sp-card primitives with unchanged copy and destinations. All PR checks passed, including standalone content, five-width standalone visual, V2 visual, selected-tour, bundle and security gates. Search/Tourvisor, analytics/Metrika, legal/payment wording, logo, verified destinations, pricing and lead transport were unchanged.
current_stage.next_action: Re-audit the representative country/editorial set at 375/430/768/1024/1440, starting with /country/ and representative country pages, then reassess the whole-site score from visible product evidence. Fix only confirmed hierarchy/spacing/wrapping/overflow/shared-shell inconsistencies; do not invent route-local visual layers. Preserve the mature search/results/selected-tour path and loaded-results instant-local-filtering architecture.

local_results_filtering.rule: Result filters such as stars/rating/price/meal and other fields already present in normalized loaded results filter the loaded set instantly. A new Tourvisor search is reserved for real search-input changes or optional background capability expansion, not for every result-filter click.

site_wide_score.note: The full first public-route hierarchy pass is now materially cleaner across /hot/, /contacts/, /how-to-buy/ and /rb/, with shared DS2 primitives and five-width visual checks all green. This supports a small whole-product increase while the representative country/editorial re-audit remains the next evidence slice.
